eventDetail.scope: Radar2026, themed Radar for Next-Generation Sensing, will highlight cutting-edge advances in radar technologies for diverse applications. Main Topics include, but are not limited to: Radar Systems and Applications, Radar Signal and Data Processing, Radar Imaging and Interpretation, Advanced RF, Sub-Systems, Components, Antenna Technology, Target and Environment Characteristics, Radar for Health, Integrated Sensing and Communication, Radar for Autonomous Driving, Radar Information Intelligent Learning and Processing, Emerging Radar Technologies, New Materials Application.
